title: Edge AI Hardware Porting Frameworks: A Survey
abstract: We review lightweight compilation and quantisation pipelines for porting Deep Learning models to resource-constrained microcontrollers.

title: Machine Learning in Healthcare Diagnostics
abstract: A comprehensive study on transformer architectures applied to medical imaging and clinical diagnostic prediction.

title: Ethics and Auditing in Medical Artificial Intelligence
abstract: Frameworks for bias mitigation, explainability, and regulatory compliance in automated diagnostic decision support systems.

title: Optimizing On-Device Neural Execution on Heterogeneous Microcontrollers
abstract: Presents runtime execution scheduling and dynamic memory allocation routines for low-power edge TPU acceleration.

title: Benchmark Protocols for Edge Acceleration Frameworks
abstract: Establishes standardized benchmark metrics for measuring latency, peak SRAM usage, and power draw across edge inference runtimes.
